narr: An upper level low pulled moisture from the remnants of Tropical Storm Alvin into the Desert Southwest, fueling thunderstorms which produced severe weather and flash flooding.
ev: Several roads were flooded, and at least five cars were stuck in the water.
The shoulder of Highway 62 was washed out.
Goffs Road was flooded and closed.
Needles Highway was flooded at Budweiser Road and between Park Road and Aha Macav Parkway.
Kelbaker Road was flooded with water, debris, and large rocks.
Approximately two feet of water flowed through the intersection of Highways 190 and 127, trapping the occupants of one vehicle.
